game_id_relation.reason: PBP game IDs map to schedule and completed scored games have PBP

play_id_uniqueness.reason: No duplicated non-null game/play ID pairs in observed PBP

snap_no_nulls.reason: Only NA-free snap rows, not player validity

player_identity_quarantine_threshold.reason: Allow <=0.5% excluded snap rows ONLY if every excluded row is accounted for and quarantined. This does not validate affected player/match projections; those remain blocked.

player_week_team_join.reason: Exact GSIS + team + week agreement between roster, play and snaps — no passing test evidence

official_cross_source_agreement.reason: Validated ESPN/NFL official score, individual stats and snaps concordance — no passing test evidence

injury_all_positions_asof.reason: Pregame injury and inactives with publication timestamp, substitutions across all positions — no passing test evidence

coaches_and_matchups.reason: Coach stints, playcalling, lineup, styles and matching validated — no passing test evidence

weather_forecasts_asof.reason: Forecast snapshots captured before game / bet — no passing test evidence

odds_market_asof.reason: Book, legal market, rules, line and observed historical timestamp — no passing test evidence

historical_multi_season.reason: Long-term full historical audit and missingness by role — no passing test evidence

raw_ingestion_persistence.reason: Immutable authorized durable data storage in Supabase — no passing test evidence

dataset_licensing.reason: Machine-verified right to store and process each source — no passing test evidence

model_input_lineage.reason: Provenance and feature hashes, all injuries invalidate calculations — no passing test evidence

policy: Do not predict or propose actual bets until ALL gates passed and a separate calibration audit succeeds.
